'''2019 NAC Greg Nirshberg DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Nirshberg]] at [[2019 North American Continental Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Greg Nirshberg]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 North American Continental Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Invasion Nirshberg DS 2019 PC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-north-american-continentals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804025510/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-north-american-continentals/ Internet Archive]
